subject: Quantus discovery recap & action plan
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quantus discovery follow-up / next steps

Evelyn — thanks for the intro call earlier today. Quick summary from my side so we have alignment before I loop in procurement: 

Key pain points:
- High per-token inference cost on current provider causing margin pressure on our consumer feature.
- Unpredictable latency during peak windows; spikes are impacting user experience.
- No easy way to pin model versions across environments (dev/stage/prod).

Goals we want to hit in a pilot (6–8 weeks):
1) Serve model in prod-like environment with median latency < 180ms for 512-token requests.
2) Achieve at least 30% cost reduction / inference compared to our current baseline.
3) Verify a reproducible rollout path (canary -> full) and audit logs for data access.

Questions for Redwood:
- Do you have a recommended MAP for a pilot that includes roles/stakeholders?
- Any preliminary pricing range for expected qps of ~250 sustained, 500 burst?

If you send a short MAP and a one-page pricing ballpark, I can schedule procurement next week.

Thanks — Dan
Daniel Cho
Head of AI Product | Quantus Health
[Attachment: call-recording-20261102.mp3 (audio)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantus discovery follow-up / next steps

Dan — really appreciate the clear summary. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a one-page cost sketch for the pilot. High level:

Pilot scope (6 weeks):
- Week 1: Provision dedicated pilot capacity, baseline telemetry and SLA targets. Owner: Quantus engineering (Priya) + Redwood onboarding (Evelyn).
- Week 2–3: Model upload/compatibility work, quantization & perf tuning, end-to-end validation on staging. Owner: Redwood SRE (Karthik).
- Week 4: Canary deploy to 5% traffic, monitor latency/cost, iterate. Owner: Quantus product + Redwood SRE.
- Week 5: Full rollout and regression checks.
- Week 6: Post-pilot review, unit-cost analysis, and procurement handoff.

Decision criteria:
- Median latency <= 180ms for 512 tokens; 95th percentile under 300ms.
- Pilot cost per 1M tokens reduced by >=30% vs your baseline.
- Audit logs and access controls validated by Quantus security.

I've attached MAP-Quantus.xlsx with stakeholders and dates filled in, and a short RFP-answer PDF. Pricing page is conservative; if you share historical token volumes I can refine.

Next asks from Quantus:
- Confirm Priya as the technical owner for the pilot and procurement point of contact.
- Share expected token volumes for the pilot window.

Proposed next meeting: Thu 5 Nov, 10am PT — 30 minutes to confirm MAP and procurement timeline.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0143
[Attachments: MAP-Quantus.xlsx, RFP-answers-Quantus.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantushealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantushealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantus discovery follow-up / next steps (pricing & procurement)

Hi Priya/Dan — looping in a quick pricing note for procurement context.

Pilot pricing (ballpark for 250 sustained qps, 500 burst):
- Reserved pilot capacity + burst buffer: $18k/mo (GPU-backed, includes 24/7 on-call during pilot)
- Token-based usage: $0.0006 per input token and $0.0009 per output token (estimated to reach ~30% reduction vs your current mix)
- One-time onboarding and tuning fee: $6k (covers quantization, perf kernels, and validation).

If procurement needs a formal quote or PO language, I can generate an SOW/quote and add our standard security clauses. Evelyn — we should include the SLA targets and audit log language in the SOW.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-sow-quantus.docx]

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantushealth.com>, procurement@quantushealth.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 07:54:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantus discovery follow-up / next steps (pricing & procurement)

Thanks, team. Quick answers from my side: Priya is confirmed as technical owner, procurement looped (procurement@quantushealth.com), and we can commit to a 6-week pilot starting 11/15 if Redwood can meet the SLA and cost criteria in the MAP.

Procurement asks:
- Formal quote with line items and payment terms (Net 30)
- SOC 2 evidence and encryption/KMS details (we'll need this in parallel)
- A short escalation path if the pilot misses latency targets

We should lock the 11/15 start date by Friday EOD so procurement can prepare the PO. Happy to meet Thu 10am PT to finalize.

— Dan

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantushealth.com>, procurement@quantushealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@quantushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quantus discovery follow-up / next steps (finalizing MAP)

Dan / Priya / Procurement — great, thanks for the quick confirmations. Action items from Redwood and owners/dates (I mirrored the MAP and pushed a few internal owners):

1) Finalize SOW & formal quote (Ben) — deliverable: draft SOW + line-item quote by Fri 11/6 EOD.
2) Provision pilot capacity & onboarding kickoff (Karthik / Redwood SRE) — kickoff meeting 11/15, target completion of provisioning by 11/16.
3) Security evidence package (security@redwood.ai) — send SOC 2 summary and KMS integration details by Mon 11/8.
4) Pilot monitoring dashboard & alert thresholds (Evelyn/Karthik) — shared dashboard link and alert rules by 11/17.
5) Post-pilot review and decision checkpoint (All) — meeting 12/23 to review metrics and decide on expansion.

Risks called out:
- If token-volume projections exceed estimates by >2x, cost targets may need rework (we'll surface this in week 2).
- Integration windows for your on-prem data connectors may add 3–5 days; Priya, can you confirm access timelines?

Next meeting confirmed: Thu, 5 Nov 2026, 10:00am PT — Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9812345678

I'll upload the signed MAP and a short risk register to the Drive link and tag procurement. Thanks again — excited to get started.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | T: +1 (415) 555-0143
[Attachments uploaded: MAP-Quantus.xlsx, RFP-answers-Quantus.pdf]
